description: Configure SMS/phone number access. Supports Google Voice legacy forwarding and direct 46elks provider delivery/webhooks.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

apiUrl.description: 46elks only: optional API base URL override

forwardingEmail.description: Google Voice only: email address Google Voice forwards SMS to (defaults to agent email)

forwardingPassword.description: Google Voice only: app password for a separate forwarding Gmail

phoneNumber.description: SMS phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +46701234567 or +12125551234)

webhookSecret.description: 46elks only: shared secret required on inbound SMS webhooks

name: sms_setup
